name: api-and-interface-design
tagline_zh: 前后端撕逼前，先让 AI 把边界钉死。REST 还是 GraphQL？模块间类型契约？它连你没想到的边界都帮你划清。
tagline_en: Before frontend vs backend fights, let AI nail the boundaries. REST or GraphQL? Type contracts? It even draws.
desc_en: Guides stable API and interface design. Use when designing APIs, module boundaries, or any public interface. Use when creating REST or GraphQL endpoints, defining type contracts between modules, or establishing boundaries between frontend and backend.
why_zh: 同类只会给模板，它逼你思考每个公开接口的稳定性，连模块间隐式依赖都揪出来。
why_en: Others give templates; this forces you to think about stability of every public interface, even catching implicit module.
